defects.what: Default sort by updated scatters SLA-breaching tickets; 'SLA at risk' is a quiet fifth tab
Priority and status are look-alike coloured pills with overlapping hues
Identical avatars and bold subjects everywhere: emphasis distinguishes nothing
11px uppercase headers, 12px mono IDs and disabled pager arrows are low contrast
16px checkboxes, 28px kebab and pager buttons; under 44px on phone
At 390px the table is cut off with no cue, tabs clipped, buttons collapse to unlabeled icons
'New ticket' is the most saturated element on a triage screen where it is rarely used
Three steps per filter that duplicate the tabs; no quick filters
Odd 'Is' label; popover covers headers; no match preview
Frequent actions (assign to me, resolve) hidden behind a 28px kebab; rare 'Open details' leads
Delete sits two rows under Merge with a hairline; no undo for resolve or assign
Column picker serves almost no triage task and takes prime toolbar space
On phone toggling hidden columns does nothing, so the menu misstates what shows
No reply box; resolve is emphasised before any response is written
Labels far from values; SLA due drawn like created/updated
Scrim blocks the list; no next/previous, so close-and-reopen per ticket

reviewer: Claude Sonnet, blind review of screenshots and source (never saw the rule list)
